idh.reasoning: For IDH status, the strongest MRI-clinical pattern favoring IDH-wildtype is an elderly patient with an aggressive infiltrative mass: age_years is 70, Total tumor volume (mL) and Whole Tumor Volume (mL) are very large, ED Volume (mL) and Proportion of Oedema show extensive edema, ET Volume (mL) and Proportion Enhancing show definite enhancement, NCR Volume (mL) and Proportion Necrosis show necrotic/non-enhancing core, and midline_shift_present, Effaced Ventricle, Ependymal (ventricular) Invasion, and Deep WM invasion indicate invasive mass effect. These features are more typical of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma than IDH-mutant diffuse glioma. Against IDH-wildtype, T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present and T2-FLAIR Mismatch Score support an IDH-mutant astrocytoma pattern, and Tumor Location with Cortical involvement can be seen in IDH-mutant glioma. Balancing these, the aggressive elderly-patient phenotype outweighs the mismatch feature, so the conclusion is IDH-wildtype.

Overall, the T2-FLAIR mismatch pattern and non-frontal aggressive phenotype favor non-codeleted.
